assertion_results.assertion: Step 2.3.5 dependency chain context identifies criterion as a dev-only dependency based on its presence in [dev-dependencies] in the manifest
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md Step 2.3.5 section: "Dependency chain for criterion: backend (workspace) -> criterion (direct dev-dependency) Type: direct dependency Profile: dev-only ([dev-dependencies] in backend/Cargo.toml) NOT present in production builds -- used for benchmarks only" and "criterion is declared in `[dev-dependencies]` in `backend/Cargo.toml`."

assertion_results.assertion: The dependency scope decision tree classifies criterion as 'dev-only — not shipped in production' and applies the dev-dependency remediation handling
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md: "criterion is declared in `[dev-dependencies]` in `backend/Cargo.toml`. It is used for benchmarks only and is NOT shipped in production container images. Per the dependency scope decision tree: Dev-only dependencies still represent a supply chain risk... Remediation tasks will carry the `dev-dependency` label... Priority is overridden to **Normal** regardless of CVE severity"

assertion_results.assertion: Remediation tasks include the dev-dependency label in the labels array: labels contain 'dev-dependency' alongside 'ai-generated-jira', 'Security', and the CVE ID
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md Task 1 labels: "`ai-generated-jira`, `Security`, `CVE-2026-99001`, `dev-dependency`" and Task 2 labels: "`ai-generated-jira`, `Security`, `CVE-2026-99001`, `dev-dependency`" -- all four required labels are present in both tasks.

assertion_results.assertion: Remediation task priority is set to Normal regardless of the CVE severity (CVSS 5.3 Medium) — the priority override is applied per the decision tree
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md states: "Priority: **Normal** (overrides CVE severity of Medium/CVSS 5.3)" and both Task 1 and Task 2 show "**Priority**: Normal"

assertion_results.assertion: Remediation task description includes a note indicating the dependency is dev/build-only and not shipped in production
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md Task 1 description: "This dependency is dev/build-only and is not shipped in production. Remediation priority is Normal (supply chain risk only)." Task 2 description contains the same note: "This dependency is dev/build-only and is not shipped in production. Remediation priority is Normal (supply chain risk only)."
